// the approach

How I actually do the work.

Ten operational playbooks — the systems and step-by-step frameworks behind the campaigns, pipelines, and launches. Click any card to read the full method.

Data-Driven Growth

How I Approach Growth Hacks & Strategies

I treat growth as a science, not a guessing game. My approach relies on rapid experimentation, data analysis, and scalable tactics — testing small before betting big, and tying every move to a real number.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

Data-Driven Experimentation: I test small, low-cost ideas to see what gets traction before scaling up budget or effort. Winners get more fuel; losers get killed fast — so spend always follows evidence.

Funnel Optimization: I map the entire user journey from awareness to retention, find the biggest drop-off points, and fix those first — because plugging the largest leak beats adding more traffic on top of a broken funnel.

Resourcefulness (the "hack"): I hunt for unconventional, high-impact channels and partnerships that acquire users faster and cheaper than the obvious paid routes everyone else is bidding on.

Metric Obsession: every strategy is tied to a core KPI — Customer Acquisition Cost, Lifetime Value, or Conversion Rate — so success is measured, not assumed.

Systems & Automation

How I Do AI Integration & Automation

I build systems that work while we sleep. By integrating AI and automation into daily operations, I eliminate repetitive work and free up time for the high-level strategy that actually moves the business.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

Identifying Bottlenecks: my first step is always auditing current workflows to find the repetitive, time-consuming tasks that are ripe for automation — you can't automate what you haven't mapped.

Connecting the Dots: I link tools together (Zapier, n8n, or direct APIs) so data flows seamlessly between systems without manual re-entry — removing the copy-paste work that quietly eats hours.

AI as a Co-Pilot: I use AI models for rapid prototyping, data analysis, and content generation to reach a solid first draft 10x faster — then apply human judgement to make it accurate and on-brand.

Focus on Efficiency: every automation is designed to reduce human error, lower operational costs, and speed up delivery — freeing people for the work only people can do.

Email Copywriting

How I Make Email Content

Effective email copywriting is never about creative writing; it's about absolute clarity, radical relevance, and radical empathy. When a decision-maker opens your email they subconsciously ask: "Why should I care about this right now?" If the answer isn't obvious within two sentences, it's archived.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

The Pattern-Interrupt Subject Line: avoid corporate jargon like "Synergistic Solutions for Q3." Use low-case, conversational, peer-level subject lines that look like they came from a colleague (e.g., "Hiring senior AI talent in [City] right now?").

The Problem-First Hook (Sentences 1–2): never open talking about yourself, awards, or product features. Open by articulating a burning operational friction your ICP is wrestling with that day.

The Value Pivot (Sentences 3–4): bridge the pain point instantly to a proven, friction-free mechanism or outcome. Show, don't tell, by referencing measurable benchmarks (e.g., "When working with platforms like Atomica AI, we optimized...").

The Single, Low-Friction CTA: never ask a cold prospect to read an essay, watch a video, and book a slot in one email. Ask one binary question that invites a natural reply (e.g., "Open to seeing profiles of 2 vetted engineers ready this week?").

Technical Deliverability Safeguards: copywriting is useless if you land in spam — ensure SPF, DKIM, DMARC authentication, multi-domain rotation, and gradual mailbox warm-up.

Pipeline Multiplier

How I Make Sales Sequences & Book Meetings

Sales sequences fail when they treat all prospects identically. A high-converting outbound sequence is an automated, multi-channel narrative arc designed to build familiarity, establish authority, and systematically remove hesitation across 3 to 5 touchpoints.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

Step 1 — Hyper-Segmentation & Data Hygiene: before drafting a line of copy, segment by exact vertical, tech stack, and company size. Mass-blasting a generic list destroys domain reputation.

Step 2 — The Initial Diagnostic Hook (Day 1): deploy a problem-first email focused strictly on a single operational bottleneck.

Step 3 — The Social Proof & Case Study Follow-Up (Day 4): reply directly to the original thread with concrete proof or a micro-case study (e.g., "We recently helped AI-driven teams scale engineering bandwidth by 25%...").

Step 4 — The Value-Add Resource Touchpoint (Day 7): send a short educational asset — a 3-step audit, a mini-playbook, a benchmark report — without asking for a meeting. Give value first.

Step 5 — The Soft Break-Up Email (Day 11): a polite exit note leaving the door open (e.g., "Assuming scaling capacity isn't a priority right now, I'll stop following up. If anything changes next quarter, my inbox is open."). Break-up emails generate some of the highest reply rates in outbound.

Full-Funnel Alignment

How I Do Marketing Strategy

Marketing strategy isn't a collection of isolated tactics (running ads, writing blogs, sending emails); it's a unified architectural blueprint designed to guide a stranger from complete unawareness to becoming a loyal, recurring brand advocate.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

ICP & Market Research: define the audience not just by demographics but by psychographics, operational pain points, and decision triggers. Understand exactly where they consume information.

Funnel Architecture Design

Top of Funnel (Awareness): educational content, targeted social reels, high-value webinars, and organic SEO to capture attention.

Middle of Funnel (Consideration): case studies, diagnostic audits, newsletters, and retargeting ads that build authority and trust.

Bottom of Funnel (Conversion): high-intent sales sequences, frictionless demos, transparent pricing/proposal frameworks, and onboarding incentives.

Channel Allocation & Budget Efficiency: allocate strictly to channels with verifiable unit economics, optimizing paid loops until CPA is ruthlessly lean (e.g., a $1.99 paid-search CPA through continuous optimization).

Feedback Loops & Continuous Iteration: weekly analytics reviews across GA4, CRM pipelines, and ad managers to reallocate budget toward winning variations instantly.

Multi-Channel Scale

Outreach Method

Modern outbound success requires a synchronized multi-channel approach. Relying solely on cold email or purely on social selling leaves massive pipeline revenue on the table. Outreach must be systematic, persistent, and impeccably targeted.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

Channel 1 — Precision Cold Email & Domain Rotation: high-volume, highly segmented sequences across rotated secondary domains to safeguard sender reputation while maintaining massive monthly capacity (e.g., 50,000+ sequenced touchpoints).

Channel 2 — Strategic Cold Calling & Voice Touchpoints: targeted phone outreach (e.g., 2,000+ cold calls for high-ticket technical sales like LyRise) to speak directly with decision-makers, handle objections, and secure verbal commitments.

Channel 3 — Social Selling & LinkedIn Touchpoints: pre-warming decision-makers by engaging with their content, viewing profiles, and sending personalized connection requests paired with value-first direct messages.

Channel 4 — Webinar & Event-Driven Prospecting: hosting high-value educational webinars or joining worldwide exhibitions (as executed for Atomica AI) to draw warm, high-intent leads who self-identify interest.

Quality Over Quantity

Lead Generation Method

Lead generation is useless if the leads are unqualified. Generating thousands of dead-end contacts drains sales-team morale and wastes capital. True lead generation is about building sustainable intake systems that consistently attract high-intent prospects ready to convert.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

Define High-Value Triggers: identify real-world trigger events signalling immediate need (e.g., a tech company announcing an AI funding round, a clinic launching a location, a marketplace scaling merchant operations).

Proprietary List Building & Data Scrubbing: use enrichment tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, custom scraping) plus manual verification to ensure deliverability and title accuracy.

Inbound Magnet Optimization: create high-utility lead magnets — conversion audits, ROI calculators, benchmarking reports — that trade high-value contact data for actionable insights.

Lead Scoring & Routing: automated CRM scoring (HubSpot or custom) flags high-intent prospects on engagement, visits, and submissions, routing them to reps within minutes.

From Grid to Cart

Social Media Content Creation

Static, beautiful imagery builds brand identity, but direct-response storytelling drives revenue. Across cosmetics (Gilnarosa), furniture (Umbra Egypt), fashion (Zmn Cloth), or B2B tech (Fractal Hub), social content must marry aesthetic appeal with uncompromising conversion psychology.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

The 3-Second Pattern Interrupt: design the opening visual or text hook to call out a specific pain point or desire before the user scrolls away.

Demonstrated Utility & Social Proof: never pitch features abstractly — show the product in real-world use (hair-care routines, unboxings, spatial furniture utility, software walkthroughs).

Multi-Industry Content Adaptation

For D2C / E-Commerce: aesthetic reels, styling lookbooks, and limited-time drops linked to frictionless checkouts.

For B2B / SaaS: educational carousels, thought-leadership posts, and behind-the-scenes execution breakdowns.

Consistent Publishing Calendars: rigorous calendars balancing brand storytelling, educational value, and direct-response promotional pushes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

How I Manage Teams & Projects

Great projects fail not from a lack of talent but from breakdowns in communication, ambiguous ownership, and unmanaged scope creep. Managing cross-functional teams (designers, copywriters, developers, media buyers) requires radical transparency, structured roadmaps, and unyielding QA.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

Kickoff & Scope Alignment: start every project with a documented brief — exact deliverables, success metrics, deadlines, and individual ownership.

Agile Milestone Breakdowns: divide complex campaigns or worldwide launches into 2-week sprints to eliminate overwhelm and maintain momentum.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Hubs: centralized ecosystems (Notion, Trello, Asana, Jira) keep creative, technical, and marketing teams aligned in real time.

Proactive Blocker Removal & QA: act as the operational bridge between internal teams and external stakeholders, running rigorous quality checks before presentation or launch.

Transparent Post-Mortems: weekly debriefs to evaluate wins, analyze missed benchmarks objectively, and refine workflows for the next sprint.

Compounding Knowledge

Growth & Constant Learning

In marketing, tech, and e-commerce, static knowledge decays rapidly — algorithms shift, privacy policies change, buyer behaviors evolve. Sustained excellence requires treating self-education and data analysis not as optional tasks but as a daily operational discipline.

Read the framework →Collapse ↑

Step-by-Step Execution Framework

Data-First Retrospection: treat every campaign — win or underperforming test — as a data source. Deep-dive the metrics (GA4, CRM velocity, ad CTR/CPA) to extract fundamental lessons.

Ecosystem Benchmarking: continuously monitor emerging trends across AI sales tools, deliverability protocols, social algorithm updates, and CRO best practices.

Cross-Industry Application: apply lessons from one vertical (marketplace KYC onboarding at Camlist) to another (SaaS onboarding at Atomica AI, B2B hiring pipelines at LyRise), cross-pollinating for innovation.

Relentless Skill Expansion: proactively master new tools, automation software, and data frameworks so execution capacity stays one step ahead of market demand.

Subject: Why 90% of cold email campaigns fail (and the exact playbook to fix yours)

Hey [First Name],

A hard truth in modern B2B outbound: most founders treat cold email like a digital lottery ticket. They buy 10,000 raw leads, load a generic feature-dumping template, blast a single domain, and watch sender reputation tank while open rates flatline below 10%.

After managing outbound that initiated over 53,937 total sequences while maintaining a 63.6% open rate, I've learned sustainable pipeline is never about raw volume — it's technical hygiene and psychological precision.

1. Hyper-segmentation over mass blasting: speak ruthlessly to one painful problem your ICP faces today. If they don't feel understood in the first two sentences, you're already archived.

2. Bulletproof deliverability: multi-domain rotation, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, automated warm-ups, and gradual volume scaling. Great copy still lands in spam on a broken foundation.

3. The single-CTA rule: don't ask a prospect to read an essay, watch a demo, and book a call in one email. Ask one low-friction question that invites a reply.

Want the exact multi-domain sequence template we used to scale MoM prospect growth by +166.7%? Reply "SEND" and I'll forward the full framework.

Keep building, Nirmeen Mohamed

Subject: Why aesthetic Instagram grids fail (and how to turn scrollers into buyers)

Hi [First Name],

If you run a D2C brand — cosmetics like Gilnarosa, furniture like Umbra Egypt, or fashion — you've likely fallen into the most common trap in social media: treating your feed like an art gallery.

A stunning minimalist grid is great for baseline credibility. But if it doesn't convert passive scrollers into high-intent buyers, you're not running a marketing engine — you're running an expensive digital mood board.

Top-performing short-form content marries aesthetic visual storytelling with direct-response conversion hooks. Here's the exact framework:

Sec 0–3 (Pattern-interrupt hook): you have three seconds. Never open with a logo or slow cinematic shot — call out a specific pain point or desire visually or in text.

Sec 3–15 (Demonstrated utility & proof): show the product in real-world use — texture and routine for cosmetics, craftsmanship and utility for furniture, real styling for apparel.

Sec 15–End (Frictionless CTA): direct them to link-in-bio or storefront with a clear, urgent incentive (limited drop or bundle).

Combine beautiful aesthetics with disciplined direct-response copy and social stops being a vanity metric — it becomes your most predictable revenue channel.

Let's scale, Nirmeen Mohamed

Case Study · Outbound Deliverability at scale

The Anatomy of a 63.6% Open Rate

How immaculate email infrastructure plus surgical problem-first copy produced a 63.6% open rate across 53,937 sequences — multi-domain decoupling, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and warm-up protocols.

Read full sample →Collapse ↑

Executive Overview

A 63.6% open rate across tens of thousands of outbound sequences isn't luck — it's immaculate technical infrastructure combined with surgical, problem-first copywriting. In large-scale outbound for fast-growing AI, SaaS, and tech platforms, domain health is your single most valuable operational asset.

The Challenge

The client faced diminishing returns. Previous teams relied on single-domain mass blasting, causing high spam complaints, ruined sender reputations, and open rates stagnating below 11%. Reps spent more time managing blacklisting than engaging prospects.

The Strategic Intervention

1. Infrastructure restructuring: decoupled outbound from the primary corporate domain via a secondary domain network, with fully authenticated SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records.

2. Mailbox warm-up & volume control: distributed sending across multiple secondary mailboxes with multi-week warm-up protocols and strict daily limits to build unassailable sender reputation with Gmail and Outlook.

3. Copywriting optimization: replaced generic product-heavy pitches with hyper-targeted, problem-centric messaging speaking directly to executive pain points.

Verifiable Results

Initiated and managed over 53,937 total outbound sequences.

Achieved a 63.6% average open rate and 26.1% click rate.

Drove a +166.7% MoM increase in qualified prospect invitations and meetings booked.

Article · D2C Video Conversion psychology

From Grid to Cart

Why modern consumers don't buy from static studio photography, and how Gilnarosa, Umbra Egypt, Zmn Cloth, and The Noviera dissolved the line between brand-building and performance marketing.

Read full sample →Collapse ↑

Introduction

Modern consumers are sophisticated and skeptical. They don't buy high-end cosmetics, furniture, or apparel from static, heavily edited studio photography — they buy on demonstrated utility, authentic validation, and immediate visual trust.

Yet many brands waste budget treating Instagram Reels and TikTok as billboard space rather than dynamic direct-response funnels.

Aesthetics Meet Direct Response

Scaling D2C brands — Gilnarosa, Umbra Egypt, Zmn Cloth, and The Noviera — showed me the best strategies dissolve the boundary between organic brand-building and performance marketing.

For Gilnarosa: educational hair-care routines and real-time application over traditional product shots. For Umbra Egypt: lifestyle reels on functional craftsmanship and home integration. For Zmn Cloth and The Noviera: trend-focused styling and seasonal lookbooks replacing static ones.

The Mechanics of Conversion-Driven Content

1. Immediate pattern interruption: a powerful visual or conceptual hook within the first 2 seconds addressing a specific desire or frustration.

2. Radical transparency and utility: show the product solving a real problem to build instant confidence.

3. Zero-friction CTA: effortless transition from viewer to buyer via a streamlined mobile checkout, turning intent into GMV.

Executed correctly, short-form video becomes a compounding, high-margin sales channel — not a vanity metric machine.

Case Study · Marketplace Onboarding ops

Reducing Marketplace Churn via KYC

How redesigned seller onboarding and automated KYC at Camlist held 99% verification accuracy while lifting conversions 25%, GMV 20%, and cutting churn 22%.

Read full sample →Collapse ↑

Executive Summary

In multi-sided marketplaces, the onboarding funnel is the single most critical inflection point governing retention, liquidity, and LTV. If a merchant hits verification friction or bureaucratic delay during KYC, drop-off spikes before a single transaction occurs.

The Operational Challenge

Managing seller operations for platforms like Camlist, we found high friction during account activation and identity verification was driving merchants away, stunting GMV, and increasing early-stage churn.

The Strategic Intervention

1. Onboarding workflow optimization: redesigned the end-to-end journey from registration to first listing, eliminating unnecessary steps.

2. Automated compliance & verification: streamlined KYC workflows that cut manual review time while maintaining full regulatory compliance.

3. Proactive merchant success: communication triggers, automated onboarding sequences, and account management guiding merchants through their first weeks.

Verifiable Business Impact

Maintained a 99% KYC verification accuracy rate without sacrificing speed.

Raised platform conversion rates by 25%.

Expanded GMV by 20% and subscription growth by 30%.

Compressed customer churn by 22% while elevating merchant satisfaction.

Article · Recruiting Talent acquisition

The AI Talent Crunch

How tech startups win top-tier LLM and ML engineers by treating candidate sourcing like high-ticket B2B sales — proactive outbound, technical credibility, and community-building webinars.

Read full sample →Collapse ↑

Introduction

Scaling tech enterprises and AI platforms face an unprecedented global talent crunch. Securing specialized LLM architects, ML researchers, and senior backend engineers is one of the most competitive battlegrounds in recruitment.

Traditional inbound job postings rarely yield qualified technical candidates — top talent is comfortably employed, well compensated, and bombarded by generic recruiter pitches.

The Outbound Talent Playbook

As a Growth Operations Specialist at LyRise, scaling AI talent acquisition meant treating candidate sourcing with the same rigor, data discipline, and personalization as high-ticket enterprise B2B sales.

1. Proactive outbound sourcing: targeted multi-channel sequences reaching passive engineers based on GitHub contributions, open-source repos, and stack expertise.

2. Technical credibility and context: outreach demonstrating genuine understanding of ML frameworks and deployment pipelines, establishing peer-level respect.

3. Community-building and thought leadership: high-value AI webinars drawing 500+ attendees, positioning the platform as an authoritative talent hub.

Verifiable Outcomes

Treating candidate acquisition as a precision growth funnel boosted qualified hiring opportunities by 20%, generated 25% revenue growth, and reduced time-to-close for scaling tech clients.

Playbook · Strategy Strategy · content · data

The Full-Funnel Growth Playbook

Growth as a systems-engineering problem — bridging data-driven attribution ($1.99 CPA, 22.41% CTR), cross-functional project leadership, and lifecycle retention into compounding revenue loops.

Read full sample →Collapse ↑

Executive Introduction

Compounding growth is rarely one successful ad or one newsletter. Sustainable scale means orchestrating a cross-functional ecosystem where product value, lifecycle success, direct-response copy, and rigorous analytics intersect.

Across 8 years in tech, SaaS, AI, and e-commerce, the highest ROI always comes from unifying teams around clear, measurable KPI baselines — turning fragmented efforts into predictable revenue loops.

1. Data-Driven Attribution & Funnel Optimization

Marketing without data is guesswork. Every campaign, landing-page variant, and sequence must be tracked through multi-touch attribution — whether hitting a $1.99 CPA on paid search or configuring HubSpot nurture flows driving a 22.41% CTR.

2. Cross-Functional Project Leadership

High-stakes initiatives — international launches, marketplace expansions, worldwide exhibitions — fail when silos exist between engineering, design, and sales. Rigorous project frameworks, clear roadmaps, and QA standards ensure flawless execution.

3. Lifecycle Retention & LTV Maximization

Acquisition is half the battle; profitability lives in retention. Automated onboarding, proactive churn-reduction triggers, and loyalty programs compress churn and maximize lifetime value.

Growth is ultimately a systems-engineering problem: creative storytelling plus operational discipline, data, and flawless execution turn marketing from a cost center into an engine for exponential revenue.
